title: 2-year-old girl with diarrhoea
arrival: A 2-year-old girl is brought in by her mother with diarrhoea for three days.
keyCriterion: Red — Circulation: any two of lethargy, sunken eyes, very slow skin pinch, drinks poorly
feedbackWhy: She has two of the listed findings together: sunken eyes and drinking poorly. Any two of lethargy, sunken eyes, very slow skin pinch and drinking poorly meet a red Circulation criterion, so she should be moved to the high acuity area immediately.
reviewNote: CLINICIAN REVIEW REQUIRED: confirm that sunken eyes plus drinking poorly are the right two findings, and that her other values (lethargy absent, skin pinch normal) stay on the safe side. Age band 1-4 years (HR 80-160, RR 20-40). Every value is proposed.

design.intendedChallenge: In children, a red Circulation criterion can need two findings together. Either of these findings alone would not be enough, so the learner has to find both.
design.expectedCommonError: triaging as yellow (ongoing diarrhoea or dehydration), which under-triages her.

unresponsive.text: Awake. Responds to her mother's voice.

airway_red.text: No stridor. No chest indrawing. No central cyanosis.

circulation_red.text: Pulse strong. Extremities warm. Capillary refill 2 seconds. No bleeding. Awake and interacting. Eyes look sunken. Skin pinch returns to normal at once. Drinks poorly when offered a cup.

disability_red.text: No convulsions. Awake and interacting. Not confused, restless or irritable. No stiff neck.

other_red.text: Age 2 years. No trauma, poisoning, threatened limb or snake bite.

airway_yellow.text: No swelling of the mouth, throat or neck. No wheezing.

circulation_yellow.text: Several watery stools today. No vomiting. Drinks poorly when offered a cup. Not pale.

disability_yellow.text: Awake and interacting. Not restless or irritable. No severe pain.

other_yellow.text: No visible wasting. No swelling of both feet. No rash. No trauma. No known surgical diagnosis.
